commitCadence: Commit after each independently verified slice and Theseus workspace validation.
stopConditions: Stop immediately if semantic math or lineage, searchable prose, URL restoration, scroll or rewind authority, static output, KaTeX identity, font metrics, review history, or production exclusion regresses.

slices.title: Successor contract
slices.summary: Created the approved 25-slice successor contract with explicit exemplar, preservation, rollback, verification, stop, and no-generalization boundaries; the rejected v1 checkpoint remains immutable history.

slices.summary: Captured the live 390x844 solve-x review state at progress 833. The 366px opaque panel consumes the lower 413px of the viewport and fully hides underlying annotated content; masthead separation remains border-only, while card geometry and global scrolling stay intact.

slices.title: Review panel translucency
slices.summary: Changed only the review chrome to 86% surface opacity while retaining the fully opaque textarea. Focused review-shell browser tests prove the panel alpha, no page reflow, Escape focus restoration, and narrow-viewport fit.

slices.title: Review panel focus and stacking
slices.summary: Made the canonical relation-color focus ring an explicit shell token and contracted the review host stacking, dialog pointer authority, opaque input surface, and 3px focus affordance. Three focused browser tests pass across real dev mount and narrow shell.

slices.title: Masthead elevation
slices.summary: Added a narrow 1px contact shadow plus a diffuse low-alpha 30px elevation field to the translucent sticky masthead. Focused browser tests prove the exact treatment, desktop and phone separation, global scrolling, non-overlap, and keyboard focus.

slices.title: Review UI visual gate
slices.summary: Passed the first exemplar checkpoint. Live desktop and phone captures show underlying annotated content through 86% review chrome, opaque input text, unchanged panel and card geometry, and restrained masthead elevation; five integrated browser tests pass.

slices.title: Collision-clearance invariant
slices.summary: Added renderer-neutral rectangular ink clearance evidence for explicitly authored moving/protected semantic pairs. It distinguishes overlap, insufficient clearance, safe diagonal separation, and invisible ink without imposing false constraints on normal adjacent typography; three unit laws and the full typecheck pass.

slices.title: Swept-bound sampling
slices.summary: Extended clearance evidence with stable-identity temporal densification bounded by both spatial and progress steps. Safe endpoints can no longer hide an intervening crossing; five unit laws cover crossing detection, genuine clearance, visibility, overlap, and near misses, and the full typecheck passes.

slices.title: Lane reservation policy
slices.summary: Added an independently inferred continuant presentation recipe with a conservative concurrent default and a solve-x-only reserve-then-transit selection. The reader exposes the selected recipe diagnostically; four policy tests prove isolation, fallback, inference, and strict unknown-value rejection, and the full typecheck passes.

slices.title: Continuant ordering
slices.summary: Wired reserve-then-transit through measured geometry, editor and reader sampling. In solve-x, persistent x and equals reflow from 0.08 to 0.26, pause, and fully settle before focal transit begins at 0.32; concurrent remains the default elsewhere. Fifteen unit laws, four successor browser tests, exact rewind, and the full typecheck pass.

slices.title: Solve-x collision gate
slices.summary: The dense gate exposed that moving x and equals first still placed equals through seven. Added transit-then-reflow: focal 7 minus 3 clears before x and equals move into the newly free target lane. Five desktop/phone successor browser tests, dense 1px interpolation, fourteen scheduling laws, and the full typecheck pass.

slices.title: Seek and rewind clearance
slices.summary: Extended the real-browser clearance gate through every 4-permille sample from 780 to 940 in both directions and both desktop and phone layouts. Every five-symbol pose retraces within 0.1px and four opacity decimals, remains collision-free after 1px interpolation, and reports rewind authority; the full typecheck passes.

slices.title: Counter-convergence roles
slices.summary: Audited and preserved the existing semantic model rather than duplicating it: seven and three are authored material inputs with upper and lower propagation ranks, minus is a non-contributing catalyst with explicit retirement, and result lineage excludes the catalyst. Eighteen choreography and synthesis laws pass.

slices.title: Counter-convergence trajectories
slices.summary: Added a typed counter-convergence successor recipe and selected it only for solve-x. It reuses the existing measured successor plan so seven follows the authored upper arc, three the lower arc, and the minus remains a catalyst; convergence-v1 remains available and other assets retain their inferred defaults. Twenty-two focused laws and the full typecheck pass.

slices.title: Counter-convergence junction
slices.summary: Added counter-specific handoff timing on the existing measured junction. Seven and three approach on opposing arcs; minus retires continuously on its own catalyst clock; material inputs then retire; four seeds from the junction only near the end of retirement and settles natively. Nineteen unit laws, five desktop/phone browser gates, dense continuity, rewind, and typecheck pass.

slices.title: Counter-convergence visual gate
slices.summary: Desktop and phone live-stage captures were inspected at six causal instants. The 7 and 3 follow distinct upper/lower approaches, the minus retires before the result appears, 4 is gated until source retirement, protected x and equals stay clear, KaTeX identity remains stable, and exact forward/rewind settlement is covered by the focused browser and unit gates.

slices.title: Streamlined zero default

The independent-zero renderer, typed recipe, and its unit laws remain intact for an explicit teacher variant. Focused policy, external-port, cancellation, cross-surface, and TypeScript checks pass.

slices.title: Zero-transition gate
slices.summary: Dense desktop and phone sampling now covers progress 480-680 every four permille forward and on rewind. It proves +0 remains absent, protected x and equals remain fully legible, cancellation ink retires continuously, and movement stays bounded. The gate exposed a 16px phase-boundary snap; zero-free presentations now distribute survivor compaction across the retiring-ink interval while explicit witness presentations retain their later timing. Five focused browser gates, fifteen choreography/policy laws, and TypeScript pass.

slices.title: Teacher zero state

A preservation law proves the state does not leak into the streamlined asset. Eleven focused semantic and animation laws plus TypeScript pass.
